name: Ikusaka (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ikusaka village emblem in white: a stylised device of a winged top above a ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ikusaka, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ikusaka village emblem — a stylised device of a winged top above a ring, like a stylised character
